decision: Quarantine undivided report supervision for single-knee training until report-block to imaged examination binding is established; all12 targets remain masked. Preserve raw report, images and official gold unchanged.
established: Two independent source assessments identify two standalone reports: first explicitly right knee, second unsided. Both blocks and literal BILATERAL note already exist in the current official CSV.
not_established: Two different knees or patients, temporal order, and which report matches the image examination remain unproven. Neither shared PatientID nor absence of endpoint flags resolves correspondence.
limits: Lexical first/last SOP UIDs are not spatial endpoints and do not exhaust within-series variation.

Prefix hashes authenticate the received prefix locally, not the full LFS object. Source OID, expected size, transport range and all three UIDs are bound; complete-file SHA verified only when entire small file was received.

Missing laterality never implies right; repeated sequence descriptions may be ordinary repeat acquisitions. Candidate flags do not establish bilateral anatomy, diagnostic labels, or training inclusion.

Whitelisted header fields are read only before PixelData; fields after PixelData, enhanced per-frame nested metadata and unselected middle slices are outside coverage. No pixel arrays decoded or stored.
